effects.printed_clause: Activate one: negate a targeted opponent Effect Monster, then optionally remove 2 Current Counters and destroy an opponent card; OR Special Summon an "Ohmen" from Deck.
effects.lua_implementation: Activation chooses a legal branch; branch one targets and continuously disables the monster, optionally removes exactly two distributed counters at resolution and non-target destroys; branch two Special Summons a filtered Deck Ohmen.

official_references.matched_structure: Target/effect negation and follow-up operation structure.
Archetypal monster Special Summon from Deck.

effects.printed_clause: Only 1 activation per turn, and after activation only Thunder monsters may be Special Summoned.
effects.lua_implementation: Oath count limit and custom activity counter forbid activation after a prior non-Thunder summon and register an end-turn non-Thunder Special Summon lock as activation cost.

official_references.matched_structure: All-turn summon-history check plus rest-of-turn type/archetype summon lock.

coverage_override.reason: The two printed bullets are mutually exclusive branches of one activation effect and are fully covered together. The shared activation HOPT and Thunder-only Summon oath are covered by record 2.
